entities.summary: Mongol, a notable figure in the history of Uzbekistan, associated with Mongol Conquest and Chagatai Khanate (1227–1370). Preceded by Chagatai Khanate and Recovery and Mongol Devastation of Transoxiana. Their legacy influenced Timur conquers Samarkand and makes it his imperial capital.
